note: Lutheran camp and retreat center on Lake of the Ozarks that rents its RV and tent sites to the public by the night. The RV sites are pull-ins off a wooded lane above the lake, beside the athletic field; summer camp and group retreats share the grounds. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40 (operator page, now manual), 17 FHU sites 30/50 A, year-round, phone booking up to a year ahead. Public nightly sales: yes. Google 4.6/126. Not waterfront confirmed (RV lane ~200 m from shore through woods). Pin is the retreat center; move to the RV lane.
flags: PRIVATE CHECKS: price $40 under the $50 gate (no gateway within 40 km, not needed). Presence: operator site + phone 660-668-2363 (matches stored) + Google 'Heit's Point Lutheran Ministry' 4.6 (126 reviews, read 2026-11-09). Sells to the general public: 'Perfect for your family, church group, reunion, or a quiet getaway ... or an RV site'. Long-stay tests: no weekly/monthly/seasonal rate, no age/rig rule, no seasonal-site language anywhere on the page - a camp selling nights, passes.

FEE CAVEAT (not written): the page also says 'Amenities use is available for families for $20, retreats up to 50 people for $100, and groups over 50 for $200'. Read as an optional add-on, since the RV listing itself includes 'Access to all the amenities Heit's Point has to offer', so not added to the nightly rate. If it were a mandatory per-stay family fee, a one-night stay would total $60 (over the $50 gate) and two nights $50 a night; a phone check would settle it.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront, confirmed): the RV pull-ins (map: both sides of 'LFC Highway' below Ascension house, athletic field to the east) sit at ~38.2725,-93.2063; the nearest Lake of the Ozarks shore is ~200 m west through continuous forest. Only the lodge/cabins are lakefront ('Lake Front Cabin #2/#3').
PIN: stored 38.2733,-93.2083 is the Spitz retreat center / dining hall parking. Move to the RV lane 38.2725,-93.2063 (~190 m E).

WEBSITE: the stored Google Sites page renders only as a shell to plain HTTP; its content is an embedded page at https://erukisha.github.io/HeitsPointLodgesRetreats/ (same operator content: phone, address 28345 Heits Point Ave., Lincoln MO). Stored URL still works in a browser - keep it.
RIG FIT: no length rule published; pull-in spurs look short-to-medium in imagery (~10-15 m) - a 23-ft rig fits on most. Not a criteria issue.
